title: Docker build broken: fedistract deps missing from context
description: The Dockerfile only COPYs Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, and src/, but Cargo.toml references ../fedistract/* path dependencies. Docker build fails because those crates aren't in the build context. Need to either restructure the Dockerfile to include fedistract, or publish the deps to a registry. GH Actions workflow also affected.
close_reason: Fixed: Dockerfile now uses parent dir as build context to include fedistract deps. compose.yaml updated. Verified build succeeds and binary runs.
